algorithm.domain_terminator: one 0x00 byte follows the ASCII prefix
notes: media_present is exactly 0 or 1. Absent media uses 0 and has NO length field.
Present media uses 1, must be 1..128 ASCII bytes, and includes its two-byte big-endian length.
An empty media type is INVALID - it is not an alias for absence, and the two must not collide.
payload_len is the exact byte length and always precedes the payload, including when it is empty.
No JSON, no UTF-8 normalization, and no endpoint field, message ID, or timestamp participates.

$comment: Inputs are hex so no encoding of this file can change what is hashed; payload_utf8 is a reader convenience, never the input. Only the vector carrying frozen_by is a re-frozen golden from an ADR - the rest are derived from the same algorithm to pin the edges an implementation gets wrong. tools/checks/verify_fixture_vectors.py recomputes all of them.

vectors.name: golden-text-plain-hello
vectors.description: The re-frozen golden from ADR-0047. Its value changed when the wire namespace became `interweave`, because the domain prefix participates in the hash.

vectors.name: absent-media-same-payload
vectors.description: Same payload, media type ABSENT. Must not equal the golden — this is exactly what the media_present byte separates.

vectors.name: absent-media-empty-payload
vectors.description: Empty payload, media absent. The four-byte length still precedes the zero-length payload.

vectors.name: present-media-empty-payload
vectors.description: Empty payload with a present media type. Distinct from the absent-media empty payload above.

vectors.name: human-chat-envelope-media
vectors.description: The human chat media type from ADR-0047, exercising a media string containing `+`, `;`, and `=`.

vectors.name: media-length-boundary-128
vectors.description: Media type at the 128-byte ceiling. One byte more is invalid input, not a longer hash input.

vectors.name: payload-high-bytes
vectors.description: Payload bytes outside ASCII, hashed as raw bytes with no normalization.
